desc:
🧱 Build anything in this block building sandbox! 400+ blocks, build with friends, TNT and Nukes - builds save in FREE private servers!

💾 SAVE your builds in free private servers and keep building later
🏰 BUILD a house, mansion, castle, city, pixel art or anything you can imagine
🪑 400+ BLOCKS: furniture, pets, neon, glass, stairs, slabs, water, lava and more
👥 BUILD WITH FRIENDS - invite them and create together
💣 TROLL and destroy with TNT, Nukes and Lucky Blocks
🛡️ SHIELD your build so nobody can break it
🕊️ FLY around to build faster
🎁 FREE TNT every 15 minutes + Daily Rewards
📱 Play on phone, tablet, PC and console

What will you build first? 👀

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for more blocks and updates!
